r1_refusals.name: single-handed climate failure
r1_refusals.quote:
No matter what one country can do on its own to mitigate the effects
              of climate change and to adapt to further changes, it is destined to fail if it acts
              single-handedly.
r1_refusals.reason: 条件句：一国若单独做减缓和适应，就注定失败。失败没有他给出的度量，单独行动也没有他给出的公共状态。用排放量或气温代替失败，会换成另一个对象。不导入。
r1_refusals.withdrawal_note: r1 拒绝过窄。r2 按原文连续引文导入为预测，评估为暂无法判断，不评分。r1 理由保留。

r1_refusals.name: failed democracy
r1_refusals.quote:
a democracy that does not take the future into consideration
              within the confines of the present’s interests in the future is a failed democracy.
              All democracies must be future-oriented in order to be present democracies.
r1_refusals.reason: 定义和规范：不把未来放进当下利益里的民主，在他的理论里就是失败的民主；must be 是应当。不是民主将在某日崩溃的预测。

r1_refusals.name: adversaries of liberty
r1_refusals.quote:
leaving the door open for
              adversaries of liberty to enter at any time is bound to have bad results. Eventu-
              ally, they will come in – even more so if the door is wide open.
r1_refusals.reason: 机制：给自由的对手留门，他们终将进来。没有公共对象，也没有期限。

r1_refusals.name: literature will develop
r1_refusals.quote:
Further discussion in the literature in this respect is still wanting and is likely to
                develop in the near future.
r1_refusals.reason: 脚注里的文献展望。没有他给出的篇数或范围，near future 不能记成一个可核验的系列。
r1_refusals.withdrawal_note: r1 拒绝过窄。r2 按原文连续引文导入为预测，评估为暂无法判断，不评分。r1 理由保留。

r1_refusals.name: re-election sensitivity
r1_refusals.quote:
Candidates who wish to be re-elected will neces-
              sarily be sensitive to this value.
r1_refusals.reason: 他设想的制度机制：想连任的候选人会对这种价值敏感。这是方案里的激励，不是对现任候选人的预测。
r1_refusals.withdrawal_note: r1 拒绝过窄。r2 按原文连续引文导入为预测，评估为暂无法判断，不评分。r1 理由保留。

r1_refusals.name: without an anchor
r1_refusals.quote:
the
              semi-future will never be able to equal in robustness and persuasion the incen-
              tives officials have for deciding strictly in view of the short term.
r1_refusals.reason: 条件句：没有正式制度锚，半未来在说服力上就永远比不过短期激励。对象是他的理论安排，不是已发生的公共结果。
r1_refusals.withdrawal_note: r1 拒绝过窄。r2 按原文连续引文导入为预测，评估为暂无法判断，不评分。r1 理由保留。

r1_refusals.name: reported autocracy share
r1_refusals.quote:
Projections show that autocracies are home to 72 per cent
           of the world’s population and that only 13 per cent live in liberal democratic
           societies today.
r1_refusals.reason: 他转述 V-Dem 2023 年报告里的当下比例，脚注写明 Papada et al. 2023。不是他自己的预测。

r1_refusals.name: reported displacement
r1_refusals.quote:
we read that 1.4 billion people could be displaced by 2060, rising to
           2 billion by 2100.
r1_refusals.reason: 他转述 Environmental Justice Foundation 2017 的 could be。2060 和 2100 是该报告的年份，不是他的预测。
